name: 48122 · Melvindale, MI
findings: ZIP 48122 (Melvindale) has 26 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48122 (Melvindale) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 7 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 48122 (Melvindale) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 52% of the typical level).
